SkipPressStart.description: Continue past the first press-start prompt. Profile selection and menu choices remain.
plugin.name: Resident Evil Revelations 2 Fusion Fix
fovfactor.description: Scales the ordinary third-person player camera. Aiming, scripted views and camera transitions keep their original field of view. The game already widens the view with the screen (Hor+).
fpslimit.description: The frame rate cap of the game's VARIABLE frame rate option (120 in the original game).
windowmode.description: The window when the game's own Full Screen option is off: with a frame, or borderless. A window as big as the screen has its frame outside the screen.
SkipIntro.description: Skip startup logos, the autosave notice and the initial service-unavailable notice.
SplitScreenVertical.description: Split local co-op left and right instead of top and bottom. On a 32:9 screen each player gets a 16:9 view. Applies when split screen starts.
SplitScreenSwapTopBottom.description: Swap the two players' views in local split-screen co-op. Applies when split screen starts.
DisableDamageOverlay.description: Hide the overlay shown at low health.
DisableFilmGrain.description: Hide the film grain and its vignette.
DisableFade.description: Disable the fade layer. Not recommended for normal play.
LightSyncRGB.description: Show both players' health on supported Logitech keyboards (Logitech G HUB).
DisableCreateQuery.description: Skip the game's wait for the GPU at the end of a frame. A performance workaround that may change rendering.
DisableGUICommandFar.description: Developer option that hides the markers of distant command targets.
hudaspect.description: Auto places side elements at the screen edges. A ratio keeps them inside a centered box.
menu.title: Plugins
menu.restarthelp: Applies the next time the game starts
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Sets the settings of this page to their defaults.
menu.restartwarning: Restart the game to apply changes.
menu.helphint: Select Details for the full help.
menu.pluginshelp: Manage this fix and other installed plugins.
menu.presethelp: Choose a preset with Left or Right, then confirm twice to apply it.
textlanguage.description: Choose the language of the fix’s settings and help. Automatic follows the Windows interface language.
checkforupdates.description: Once per start, asks fusionfix.io whether a newer version of the fix is out and tells you in the game. Off makes no network request.
update.availablehub: {name} {version} is available. FusionFixHub opens when you close the game.
cutscene.description: Choose the borders used during in-engine cutscenes.
icons.description: Choose the button symbols shown for a controller. Auto uses Xbox symbols.
pauseonfocusloss.description: Pause while another window is active. Turn off to keep the game running in the background in windowed and borderless modes; fullscreen always pauses. Applies immediately.
